purpose: Time-frozen preseason projection sources eligible or under review for FSFFL historical calibration. This inventory stores provenance only; it does not assert predictive superiority.
eligibility_rule: A snapshot must be demonstrably published no later than the opening date of the NFL regular season for that season. Same-day snapshots are flagged for manual time-of-day review before authoritative use. A retrieval mechanism that returns historical season projections is not sufficient by itself: the historical values must also be shown to represent a contemporaneous preseason snapshot rather than a mutable or reconstructed response.

The open-source ffespn package demonstrates ESPN projection retrieval for season 2022, week 0 (preseason), including detailed player fields. This establishes a reproducible retrieval lead, not a time-frozen snapshot. Do not admit these rows to calibration until independent provenance establishes that returned historical values are the contemporaneous pre-Week-1 projections.

position_expansion.rule: Before using another position-season snapshot, verify that its displayed update date matches the eligible time-frozen season snapshot rather than assuming the QB date applies to all positions.

remaining_requirement: Add at least one independent source with comparable, demonstrably time-frozen preseason snapshots and normalize projections and realized FSFFL-scored outcomes before source/blend promotion. ESPN is currently a retrieval lead only, not yet calibration-eligible.
